verdict.rationale: ANEF is a government digital-administration portal for foreign nationals, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from plugged-in MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. The probes show only a JavaScript shell behind an account and a ministry Cloudflare challenge. Nothing suggests the portal ships agent or MCP-client functionality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
